thread:
Maria Chen: heads up — finalizing the rollout windows for next week's release. need a quick alignment on canary timing and branch cutoffs across regions. can we avoid any overlap that might double-schedule canaries?

Devon Patel: propose we do staggered canaries: US first, then EU, then APAC. keeps traffic predictable.

Maria Chen: +1. rough windows? put times in UTC pls so ops can validate.

Devon Patel: US canary 2026-04-02 02:00–03:00 UTC (low traffic), EU canary 04:00–05:00 UTC, APAC canary 10:00–11:00 UTC. each 1h canary then 1h gradual ramp.

ops-bot: Deploy plan template created: https://deploys.redwood.internal/plans/rl-2026-04-02-196857 — automated checks scheduled.

Li Wang: will the canaries share the same model variant? we need to ensure KV cache warmup between canaries or risk thundering.

Devon Patel: yes same variant. plan is to snapshot caches from staging for first canary, then rely on prefix cache + 5m warmup before traffic. I'll add warmup jobs.

Samir Khan: quick reminder — bump the package and changelog before branch freeze. we want the minor bump (v1.12.0 -> v1.13.0) with changelog entry and PR link in the release notes.

Maria Chen: branch freeze time?

Jess O'Neill: branch freeze at 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC. leave exceptions for security fixes only. mention in changelog PR.

Li Wang: rollback plan? who owns immediate rollback if we see latency regression in EU canary?

Devon Patel: ops oncall will own rollback first 15m, then platform if we need model switch. I'll tag @ops-oncall in the canary runbook.

Samir Khan: changelog/PR: please add this snippet to the release notes section so QA can validate quickly:
```
- v1.13.0 — 2026-04-02
  - Feature: region-aware routing for low-latency fallbacks
  - Ops: staggered canary windows US/EU/APAC; warmup jobs added
  - Notes: branch freeze 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC; rollback handled by ops-oncall
```

Maria Chen: perfect. Devon, can you post the canary job commands here so SRE can review?

Devon Patel: sure — running warmup then canary command:
```
# warmup cache
kubectl run warmup-job --image=tools/warmup:stable -- env CONFIG=canary-warmup --replicas=3
# trigger canary
deployctl start --plan rl-2026-04-02 --stage canary --region us
```

Jess O'Neill: tagging release manager @samir for changelog approval. also reminder: update RELEASES.md with the bump line by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Canary window reminders scheduled: 2026-04-02T02:00Z, 2026-04-02T04:00Z, 2026-04-02T10:00Z. Alerts will go to #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

Li Wang: small ask — can APAC window be moved 30m later if needed to avoid local maintenance? will validate with partners.

Devon Patel: can do — margin is fine. I’ll update plan to 10:30–11:30 UTC and note variability in runbook.

Samir Khan: last thing — please attach PR link to the deploy plan and sync with docs team for the public changelog excerpt.

Maria Chen: thanks all. I'll update the release calendar and send a short summary to the release channel after changes are in. :thumbsup:
